result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` now runs the same code path as `updateLandscape`, with the same options. It compiles, but I did not run any tests. I also did not run either command, so I haven't confirmed that `analyzeLandscape` writes `config.json` and `index.html`.

- **`Commands.java`:**
  - I added `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` and a description saying it is the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`.
  - `analyzeLandscape` is now listed in the no-argument usage overview, next to `updateLandscape`.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`:**
  - The dispatch now accepts either name.
  - `-help` prints the usage for the name the user typed, so `updateLandscape -help` keeps its own usage.
- **`README.md`:** It had no command descriptions at all, so I added a short "Landscape" section. It shows `analyzeLandscape -analysisRoot <folder>`, where the report ends up, and that `updateLandscape` is the older name for the same command.
